description: This file declares the MediaPipelineClient class, which implements the IMediaPipelineClient interface for IPC communication in the Rialto media server. It includes method declarations for media event notifications and manages session and IPC client references.

classes.name: MediaPipelineClient
classes.description: A class implementing IMediaPipelineClient for handling media pipeline events via IPC.

methods.name: MediaPipelineClient
methods.description: Constructor initializing the client with session ID and IPC client reference.

methods.name: notifyNativeSize
methods.description: Notify the native video size and aspect ratio.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Request for media data with specific source ID, frame count, and shared memory info.

methods.name: notifyCancelNeedMediaData
methods.description: Cancel media data request for a specific source ID.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Notify Quality of Service information for a source.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Notify buffer underflow event for a source.
